correctness.rationale: Exact synchronous vertex updates reduce to (clique mask, hub bit, leaf-one count). All recurrent configurations are classified by the odd-r complementation boundary and the three homogeneous hub-leaf maps. The global sharp bound follows by case splitting; the s>r high-leaf entrance counts use strict binomial-majority tails and exact boundary counts. The standalone direct graph and weighted reduced-state programs passed on their stated domains. No finite trial is used to prove arbitrary r,s.

value.rationale: The exact attractor phase diagram resolves two distinct natural pendant-degree thresholds, separates parity-induced mixed oscillations from leaf-induced uniform-core oscillations, and gives a sharp constant voting-time cutoff plus an exact high-leaf entrance distribution. These are robust structural and quantitative results for an infinite two-parameter graph family rather than renamed textbook facts.
